title: ig-publish manifest
description: What to publish and in which order. The order of `items` is the publishing order. ig-publish validates the same rules itself (plus file existence, caption rules and season names from the configuration).

ig_user_id.description: Optional. If present it must equal [account] ig_user_id in the configuration.

key.description: Stable identifier used in the state file, on the command line and in the schedule.

kind.description: story (STORIES container, no caption) or reel (REELS container).

group.description: Free label used by --only. For stories: the Highlight you plan to add them to (adding is manual).

src.description: Source video (or still image for a story) relative to [paths] source_root.

caption.description: Reels only. At most 2,200 characters, 30 hashtags and 20 @-mentions.

share_to_feed.description: Reels only. Also show the reel in the main grid (default true).

thumb_offset.description: Reels only. Cover frame position in milliseconds from the start.

season.description: Name of a [seasons.NAME] table: publish only inside its window; its caption words are allowed.

still_seconds.description: For still-image sources: length of the generated video in seconds.

needs_approval.description: Hold this item back until a run passes --approve KEY. The value is the reason.

already_live.description: The item is already on the account (posted outside this tool); it counts as published.
